description: This file defines the YamlDirectoryDiscovery class, which implements directory scanning and YAML file discovery for Drupal, including caching and YAML parsing.

classes.name: YamlDirectoryDiscovery
classes.description: A class for discovering multiple YAML files in specified directories, with caching and identifier extraction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the YamlDirectoryDiscovery with directories, cache suffix, and optional identifier key.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Finds and returns all discovered YAML data, utilizing cache when available.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier from YAML data based on the configured key.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of YAML files found in the configured directories, mapped to providers.

methods.name: getDirectoryIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over files in a directory, defaulting to non-recursive YAML files.
